easytable-fpx v0.2.1

- Provides a command-line tool to check restaurant availability and manage easyTable bookings using the fpx CLI—no easytable-mcp server required.
- Routes requests via a signed-in browser tab with the Transporter extension to bypass Cloudflare protections on book.easytable.com.
- Lists booking areas, available dates/times, retrieves bookings by phone, and cancels bookings—each as a single CLI command.
- Includes setup steps for pairing the CLI with your browser, and usage recipes for all main actions.
- Creating or modifying bookings via fpx requires a manual workaround to supply the Turnstile token due to CLI limitations.
- Clarifies expected exit codes and troubleshooting for connectivity or botwall issues.
